title: Discontinuation of Binance Link Futures Bonus Reward
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians,  Effective  2026-10-09 , Binance will discontinue the Binance Link Futures Bonus Reward, as part of an update to our overall incentive framework.  The September 2026 cycle will be the final cycle eligible for payout:  Final eligible cycle : 2026-09-09 to 2026-10-08 Reward discontinuation : From 2026-10-09 This change applies specifically to the Binance Link Futures Bonus Reward and does not affect other Binance Link products, services or incentive arrangements unless otherwise communicated separately. We appreciate your understanding and continued support as we implement this change.  Note : There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2026-08-24
